written.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI staff say unreleased models are too unsafe to release publicly
written.summary: Employees at Anthropic and OpenAI have warned that internal, unreleased AI models have made rapid reasoning advances that make them unsafe for public release, according to reports citing more than two dozen insiders.

written.headline: Meta rolls out Muse personal AI agent to adults in the UK
written.summary: Meta launched its personal AI agent, Muse, to adults in the UK to help with everyday tasks such as refunds and shopping. It is the first AI agent product from a Big Tech company in the UK, arriving amid scrutiny from UK watchdogs.

written.headline: Supertake raises $20 million to let AI agents turn market predictions into stock portfolios
written.summary: AI investing startup Supertake announced a $20 million seed round led by Adjacent with participation from Coinbase Ventures and Union Square Ventures. The funding will support its service that uses frontier AI models and trading agents to convert users' market ideas into investable portfolios.

written.headline: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX over Grok's generation of child sexual abuse and non-consensual images
written.summary: Virginia Attorney General Jay Jones and Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield filed lawsuits accusing SpaceX and its subsidiaries of allowing the Grok AI image tool to create child sexual abuse material and non‑consensual intimate imagery without industry‑standard safeguards.
